parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SignatureId
parameters.description: The IDs of the keys to query.

parameters.name: SignatureName
parameters.description: The names of the keys to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-signatures --signature-id dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --signature-name backendsignature --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeSignatures --region cn-hangzhou --SignatureId dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --PageSize 10 --SignatureName backendsignature --PageNumber 1
